summary: The blueprint is broadly plausible for healthy human pancreas but needs targeted completeness and marker-design refinements.

issues.description: The blueprint covers the major pancreatic parenchymal, vascular, stromal, neural, and immune compartments, but it does not represent adipocytes or mesothelial/serosal cells, which can be expected in unrestricted human pancreas tissue preparations and atlases.
issues.suggested_fix: Add literature-grounded plain axes and modules for adipocytes and mesothelial/serosal cells if supported by the declared IF>10 pancreas/HCA atlas sources. Use canonical adipocyte markers such as ADIPOQ, PLIN1, FABP4, LPL, CFD, and appropriate mesothelial markers such as MSLN, WT1, UPK3B, KRT8/KRT19, PRG4, and PDPN, adjusted to the supporting source.

issues.description: The dendritic-cell module combines cDC2 markers, cDC1 markers, and pDC-associated LILRA4 into one gene set. These programs are biologically distinct, so a single mixed module may dilute subtype-specific dendritic-cell signal.
issues.suggested_fix: Split dendritic representation into cDC2, cDC1, and pDC modules/axes if supported by pancreas atlas resources, or narrow the existing module to a coherent broad conventional-DC/APC marker set and add a separate pDC axis only if pDCs are supported.

out_of_scope: The blueprint passes python3 embedder_blueprint.py --describe with no structural placeholder or orphan-module issue observed.
DOI and impact-factor verification were not repeated because citation verification is outside discriminator scope.
